## Exercise: The ADMIXTURE controversy

In the discussion about ADMIXTURE, you have heard about very different models
giving exactly the same ADMIXTURE result (see Figure 2 in [this
paper](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-018-05257-7/figures/2)).

**Write a simulation script for each of the three model topologies in the
figure linked above. Then use the function `ts_vcf()` to save a VCF file with
genotypes from each of those models, convert those VCF files into the PLINK
file format, and run ADMIXTURE to confirm the results of that paper.** Of
course, the PLINK conversion and ADMIXTURE analysis is something you're going
to have to do on the command-line, using the skills you've learned earlier in
this course.
